description: This file contains functions and classes related to lazy tensor graph extraction, including graph input matching, return value handling, device forcing, fallback operation detection, and the main function 'extract_compiled_graph' which optimizes a model with LTC and returns a wrapper for executing the compiled graph.

classes.name: GraphInputMatcher
classes.description: Class for matching graph inputs to method arguments or constants after lazy tracing.

classes.name: ReturnValueHandler
classes.description: Class for handling return values, especially deduplication of lazy tensors to match eager tensors.

methods.name: force_lazy_device
methods.description: Converts eager tensors created by factory methods in a Fx graph to lazy device tensors.

methods.name: get_fallback_ops
methods.description: Retrieves fallback operations that have been called during lazy execution.

methods.name: extract_compiled_graph
methods.description: Main function that optimizes a model with LTC, extracts a compiled graph, and returns a wrapper for execution.
